links.outcome: Switching from appropriate to inappropriate care across multi-turn follow-up when users state inferior preferences
links.effect: Inferior preferences substantially increased switching to inappropriate care beyond neutral drift; failures accumulated across turns, including on initially correct cases, and often carried moderate or severe potential harm.
links.quote: These failures accumulate across turns, including on cases models initially answer correctly, and often carry moderate or severe potential harm.

unlisted_practices: Testing LLM sycophancy to stated user preferences in caregiver-mediated care
Eliciting patient preferences in caregiver conversations

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluating LLM safety and sycophancy when caregiver/patient users express clinically inferior preferences across multi-turn interactions.
